assertion: From June 1 through August 31, 2026, New York City had 195 shooting incidents, 249 shooting victims, and 66 murders, each the fewest recorded during that period in NYPD history, beating prior record lows of 227 shooting incidents (2025), 293 shooting victims (2018), and 78 murders (2017).
warehouse_value: FBI Return A summer (Jun-Aug) murders for NYPD (ORI NY03030): 2017=78, 2018=92, 2019=100, 2020=158, 2022=114, 2023=108, 2024=90, 2025=88 — independently confirms 78 (2017) was genuinely the lowest prior summer count
sql: SELECT year, SUM(actual_murder) AS murders_jun_aug FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE ori='NY03030' AND month IN (6,7,8) AND year BETWEEN 2017 AND 2025 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
independent_value: NYPD PR014 (Sept 3, 2026) states identical figures verbatim: 195 shooting incidents, 249 shooting victims, 66 murders, beating prior records of 227/293/78

sources.title: NYPD Announces Safest Summer for Shooting Incidents, Shooting Victims, and Murders in Recorded History (PR014)

assertion: Major crime in New York City declined 6.6 percent in August, with 10,276 offenses vs. 11,000 in August 2025; the Bronx led the city year-to-date with an 11.9 percent major-crime decline.
independent_value: NYPD PR014 states identical figures: 10,276 vs 11,000 (-6.6%) citywide in August; Bronx 18,369 vs 20,846 (-11.9%) YTD

assertion: Utica Police Department's "double-digit percentage decrease in index crime," as cited in the governor's September 3, 2026 release, is based on a 2017-to-2026 nine-year comparison, not the one-year January-May 2025-to-2026 comparison used for the statewide GIVE aggregate figures presented in the same release.
warehouse_value: FBI Return A Jan-May index-crime (actual_all_crimes) year-over-year for Utica PD: 1,345 (2025) to 1,237 (2026), an 8.0% decline — single-digit, confirming the one-year change alone would not be described as double-digit
sql: SELECT ori, SUM(CASE WHEN year=2025 AND month BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN actual_all_crimes ELSE 0 END) AS idx_2025, SUM(CASE WHEN year=2026 AND month BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN actual_all_crimes ELSE 0 END) AS idx_2026 FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE ori = 'NY03202' GROUP BY ori
independent_value: Rome Sentinel, citing the same official DCJS GIVE data sheet, reports Utica's actual double-digit figure as a 37% decline in violent crime from 2017 to 2026 ("146 violent crimes in 2017... only 92 reported so far this year, a decrease of 37%")

sources.title: Governor: Crime numbers fall in Utica and statewide
